_comment: JS licence gate (#1832), run by `node scripts/oss-inventory.mjs check-licenses` in supply-chain.yml. The allow-list is deny.toml's [licenses] allow (shared with Rust) plus the extras below, each observed in a shipped npm tree. `packages` overrides one package whose manifest has no valid SPDX licence: `license` is what we reviewed it to be, `license_found` what its package.json said, so a changed manifest re-opens the review.

allow.reason: SIL Open Font License: the bundled fonts (@fontsource/*, @expo-google-fonts/geist). Permits bundling with software; its one condition, shipping the licence, is met by the in-app Open source licenses page.
Permissive (PSF). argparse, reached through Expo's tooling dependencies of the `expo` package.
Attribution-only data licence: caniuse-lite's browser table, reached through Expo's tooling. Attribution is met by the in-app Open source licenses page.
